🚨 TRENDING TODAY: NPF 48HR OPERATIONAL SUCCESSES 🚨

Kindly find below the Top 15 State-by-State Executive Summary of @policeNG Operational Successes for the last 48 hours:

1. ZAMFARA STATE: POLICE ENGAGEMENT FORCES BANDITS TO ABANDON FIVE ABDUCTED WOMEN
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 1230HRS, armed bandits attacked a farm in Dansadau, Maru LGA, shot dead a 35-year-old farmer, and abducted five elderly women harvesting beans.
✅ Police tactical teams and local vigilantes pursued the assailants and engaged them in a gun duel, forcing the bandits to abandon all five captives and flee.
✅ All five abducted women were rescued unhurt, while sustained bush-combing and tracking operations continue to apprehend the perpetrators.
🔹 Status: SCID Gusau Investigating.

2. NIGER STATE: JOINT RESCUE OPERATION FREES SIX ABDUCTED FARMERS
✅ On 29/10/2026, police, military, DSS, special hunters and local vigilantes traced armed bandits to their hideout in Rafi LGA.
✅ The coordinated operation successfully rescued six victims abducted while working on their farms at Mahangi Village via Pandogari.
✅ The rescued victims were received at the Division for profiling ahead of reunion with their relatives.
🔹 Status: SCID Minna Investigating.

3. KEBBI STATE: JOINT SECURITY FORCES THWART LAKURAWA ATTACK ON RIBAH
✅ On 30/10/2026 at about 2015HRS, armed men suspected to be bandits attacked Ribah Town, Danko Wasagu LGA, after an earlier attempt to block Rambo Junction was thwarted by joint security forces.
✅ The attackers regrouped and opened fire from different directions, prompting joint forces to engage them and repel the attack.
🔹 Status: SCID Birnin Kebbi Investigating.

4. KANO STATE: POLICE ARREST FIVE SUSPECTS, RECOVER 48 COWS, 43 SHEEP AND TWO MOTORCYCLES
✅ Police Anti-Kidnapping Squad operatives stormed the residence of suspects linked to the kidnapping of Alh. Abdu Fanka, APC Chairman of Rogo LGA.
✅ Although the primary suspects escaped after raising an alarm, operatives arrested five persons suspected of harbouring criminals.
✅ Police recovered 48 cows, 43 sheep and two Bajaj Boxer motorcycles during the operation.
🔹 Status: SCID Bompai Investigating.

5. KATSINA STATE: POLICE FOIL ARMED BANDITS' ATTACK ON KAROFI VILLAGE
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 2327HRS, tactical teams responded to a distress call concerning an attempted bandit attack on Karofi Village, Dutsin-Ma LGA.
✅ Police operatives intercepted the hoodlums and engaged them in a gun duel, forcing the attackers to abandon their mission and retreat into the bush.
✅ No casualty was recorded among security personnel or civilians, while combined patrols and bush-combing operations continue.
🔹 Status: SCID Katsina Investigating.

6. LAGOS STATE: POLICE ARREST CULTIST SUSPECT AFTER ARMED ROBBERY/MURDER, RECOVER FIREARM
✅ On 31/10/2026 at about 1130HRS, police operatives responded swiftly to an ongoing robbery at Desa Bus Stop, Ibeju-Lekki.
✅ Operatives arrested Ojo/Ojomu Bolanle, 28, aka “Burna”, a suspected Aiye confraternity member, following the shooting of POS operator Ibrahim Adewale Moronfade, who later died.
✅ A search led to the recovery of one locally-made pistol, one expended cartridge and charms, while the stolen handbag and other property were traced to the robbery.
🔹 Status: SCID Panti Investigating.

results.title: 7. KEBBI STATE: POLICE/MILITARY/VIGILANTE RESPONSE TO LAKURAWA TERRORIST ATTACK ✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 1745HRS, a large group of armed men
results.description:
7. KEBBI STATE: POLICE/MILITARY/VIGILANTE RESPONSE TO LAKURAWA TERRORIST ATTACK
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 1745HRS, a large group of armed men suspected to be Lakurawa terrorists invaded Dan-Indo Village, Fakai LGA.
✅ The attackers killed nine persons and set the village ablaze, burning two motor vehicles and several motorcycles.
✅ Police tactical units, military personnel and vigilantes were immediately drafted to the scene in response to the attack, while investigation and security operations continue.
🔹 Status: SCID Birnin Kebbi Investigating. 

8. ZAMFARA STATE: POLICE/MILITARY OPERATION LAUNCHES RESCUE EFFORT FOR NINE ABDUCTED PERSONS
✅ On 29/10/2026 at about 0600HRS, armed bandits invaded the Upa area on the outskirts of Kurya Madaro, Kaura Namoda LGA, and abducted nine persons.
✅ Police VCRU teams and military personnel under Operation Fansar Yamma were immediately mobilized to the scene.
✅ Combined bush-combing operations are ongoing across surrounding forests to rescue the victims and apprehend the perpetrators.
🔹 Status: SCID Gusau Investigating.

9. BENUE STATE: POLICE ARREST TWO SUSPECTS IN DEFILEMENT CASE
✅ Following a report of the alleged defilement of a 16-year-old female at Naka, Gwer West LGA, police operatives arrested two alleged accomplices.
✅ The victim was taken to General Hospital Naka, where medical examination confirmed penetration.
✅ Efforts are ongoing to apprehend the principal suspect, who remains at large.
🔹 Status: SCID Makurdi Investigating.

10. FCT ABUJA: POLICE ARREST TWO SUSPECTS OVER GRIEVOUS HURT
✅ On 29/10/2026, an argument over a snatched Tecno mobile phone escalated into a group fight in Gwagwalada.
✅ A passer-by, Zaharadenu Awalu, 19, sustained a severe cut injury to his left hand and was treated at UATH.
✅ Police operatives arrested Mensur Abdullahi, 20, and Gambo Salisu, 30, while efforts continue to apprehend fleeing accomplices.
🔹 Status: CID Abuja Investigating.

11. ANAMBRA STATE: POLICE ARREST TWO SUSPECTS OVER DEATH IN VIGILANTE CUSTODY
✅ Following a report that a suspect accused of stealing a vehicle battery was allegedly tortured and detained overnight by vigilante members at Odorober, Odekpe, resulting in his death, police operatives visited the scene.
✅ The operatives processed the scene and arrested two suspects, while efforts are ongoing to apprehend another suspect who remains at large.
🔹 Status: SCID Awka Investigating.

results.description:
Soldiers last week killed about 11 Lakurawa fighters in Dekara, Niger state. The group’s Nigeria leader, Ridwan Zakariya, was also shot in the leg.

He’ll most likely be moved to Sokoto for treatment, if he’s not been moved already.

results.title: 12 PEOPLE KILLED IN KEBBI — POLICE INSPECTOR AMONG THE DEAD.
results.description:
12 PEOPLE KILLED IN KEBBI — POLICE INSPECTOR AMONG THE DEAD.

A series of attacks and reprisal violence has left at least 12 people dead in communities across Kebbi State, according to the state police command.

The affected areas include Karwa, Kestu and Waiwayi in Koko-Besse LGA.

Police say five people were killed on October 26, while seven more, including a police inspector, died in attacks on October 28.

The command also says the violence followed an earlier incident at Samanaji Market on October 22, when local vigilantes allegedly attacked Fulani traders, leaving three people dead.

Homes and motorcycles were reportedly burnt, shops looted and residents displaced.

The police commissioner has ordered further security operations and investigations.

But beyond the death toll, a critical question remains: how did tensions escalate into repeated violence against communities, and what protection do residents now have?
